description: The plot illustrates the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio' across different sample sizes for two models on two benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled with sample sizes, presented on a linear scale with tick marks at values 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis represents the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio,' also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. The blue line, representing 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep,' starts at approximately 0.2 at 128, increases to 0.32 at 256, continues to about 0.4 at 512, and remains constant at approximately 0.4 through 1024. The orange line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep,' begins at around 0.15 at 128, rises to approximately 0.28 at 256, increases sharply to approximately 0.45 at 512, and stabilizes at that level through 1024. The green line, 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench,' starts at approximately 0.08 at 128, rises to approximately 0.2 at 256, continues to nearly 0.4 by 512, and remains constant thereafter. The red line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench,' begins at 0.25 at 128, rises to approximately 0.35 at 256, reaches approximately 0.45 at 512, and slightly increases to 0.5 at 1024.
